title: Kyphosis Evaluation Using SPINESCAN®
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the accuracy of SPINESCAN® with standard lateral x-rays of the spine in patients monitored for kyphosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients examined in scoliosis clinic for kyphosis with recent lateral spine X-rays.
* Age: 7 years old and above.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Less than 7 years old.
* No informed consent.
study_population:
Main group: patients examined in scoliosis clinic for kyphosis with recent lateral spine X-rays.

Age: 7 and above.
